Short title and commencement

SIND SERVICE TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
SIND SERVICE TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
1. Short title and commencement.‑(I) This Ordinance
may be called the Sind Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3 of Sind Act XV of 1973

SIND SERVICE TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
SIND SERVICE TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
2. Amendment of section 3 of Sind Act, XV of 1973.‑In
the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973, in section 3, after subsection (4), the
following new subsection (4‑A) shall be inserted :‑
"(4‑A).‑Notwithstanding subsection (4),
Government may, not later than 31st December 1977, curtail the term of office
of the Chairman or any member appointed before coming into force of this
subsection.".
